title: Comodito
subtitle: Comodito Carbon Heater Grey 900 W
category: Home Appliances > Appliances > OFR & Room Heaters
key_features: Works in both Horizontal or Vertical positions : Comodito can be use in any of the orientation Horizontal or Vertical. Use it as a tower heater in vertical position when far range heat is needed and use it on horizontal position for wide-spread heat.

Warm & Hot dual heat setting : Comodito comes with 2 Carbon rods, and both can be controlled as desired, for warm 1 of the rod will be working and when there are more people in the room and more heat is needed on Hot setting both the rods will be working. Total heating power is 450 W single rod & 900 W both rods.
120 Minutes Sleep Timer : Set it on 30 or 60 or 90 or 120 minutes, the specialized sleep timer in Comodito lets you choose, if you want it off in 30 minutes or after 2 hours.

Far & Medium Range Infrared Heating : Carbon heaters distributes heat uniformly across the space, carbon fiber radiates medium and far range infrared heat which delivers warmth in wider area instead of just heating the air around it. The lux intensity is also lower compared to other IR heaters better for a good night sleep.
